state.interpretation: A separately initialized second-generation repository with strong verified content lineage to Wedgettok: multiple canonical docs/source files are byte-identical at the observed heads, while at least one shared contract file has diverged. Exact replacement/successor classification still requires broader manifest/history analysis.

evidence.statement: The repository was initialized independently on 2026-09-22 with commit 907c1c2c and then developed through a short five-commit sequence to the observed head ea7872521f05a00118b4c6337ba30213c5463902.
evidence.limits: Independent initialization does not establish absence of copied code/content.

evidence.statement: README explicitly describes the repository as a calmer second-generation version of Wedgettok and names truthful Experience contracts, local-first behavior, lazy-loaded runtimes, deterministic tests, and a TikTok-style vertical feed as retained foundations.
evidence.limits: This is project-authored lineage language, not independent provenance proof.

evidence.statement: The package defines a large explicit verification surface covering contracts, host/runtime behavior, adversarial runtime probes, feed control/selection, semantic integrity, lifecycle, data truth, and build verification.
evidence.limits: The presence of test scripts does not prove current execution; the connected workflow endpoint did not surface a current run for the observed head.

evidence.statement: ROADMAP.md still names 2448d38d0a59cd3e797d761f37efb68f2d0753ea as the current baseline even though observed main is ea7872521f05a00118b4c6337ba30213c5463902.
evidence.source: ROADMAP.md versus current GitHub main commit
evidence.limits: The document calls this a documentation synchronization baseline, but the mismatch makes current-state claims unsafe until synchronized.

evidence.statement: The first commit already contained the Experience roadmap, CI/CD workflow, package/tooling, and a large implementation surface, indicating this repository was initialized as a substantial product line rather than a one-file fork created from the current Wedgettok repository.
evidence.limits: This does not prove which assets were copied from other sources.

evidence.statement: At the observed heads, docs/EXPERIENCE_MODEL.md, docs/DELIVERY_PATH.md, docs/EXPERIENCE_CAPABILITY_CONFORMANCE_V0_1.md, docs/FEED_PERFORMANCE_CONTRACT_V0_1.md, and src/data/experienceTruth.ts have identical Git blob SHA values across Wedgettok and Wedgettok-Next.
evidence.source: GitHub blob metadata for both repositories at e0b4a9599fc2aa61995fda579b0a7ea2a7054095 and ea7872521f05a00118b4c6337ba30213c5463902
evidence.limits: Byte-identical files establish content reuse/equality for those paths but do not by themselves establish when or from which repository the copying occurred.

evidence.statement: docs/ADVERSARIAL_RUNTIME_FAILURE_MATRIX.md exists in both repositories but has different blob SHA values at the observed heads, proving the second-generation line also contains divergent evolution rather than a pure snapshot.
evidence.source: GitHub blob metadata for both repositories
evidence.limits: The file-level difference does not classify whether changes are refactors, additions, or semantic redesign.

evidence.statement: Recursive Git tree comparison at the observed heads contains 135 blob paths in Wedgettok and 143 in Wedgettok-Next; 133 paths are shared, 108 shared paths have identical blob SHA values, 25 shared paths differ, 2 paths exist only in Wedgettok, and 10 only in Wedgettok-Next.
evidence.source: GitHub recursive tree API for Wedgettok@e0b4a9599fc2aa61995fda579b0a7ea2a7054095 and Wedgettok-Next@ea7872521f05a00118b4c6337ba30213c5463902
evidence.limits: Tree comparison establishes path/blob identity at the observed heads; it does not establish commit ancestry or semantic equivalence of divergent files.

suggestions: Treat Wedgettok-Next as a parallel/second-generation line until a content/history equivalence audit establishes exact lineage with Wedgettok.
Synchronize ROADMAP.md baseline and CI evidence to the actual current head before using it as a source of truth.
unknowns: Exact file/content lineage versus Wedgettok, including copied, adapted, and removed components.
Whether Next is intended to replace, succeed, or coexist with Wedgettok.
Current CI execution state for ea7872521f05a00118b4c6337ba30213c5463902.
Full manifest-level copy/adapt/delete mapping between the two repositories.
Whether Wedgettok-Next is intended to replace, coexist with, or selectively extract from Wedgettok.
contradictions: ROADMAP current baseline is stale relative to main HEAD.

evidence_refs: Observed identical Git blob SHAs across five shared files
Observed divergent Git blob SHA for ADVERSARIAL_RUNTIME_FAILURE_MATRIX.md
relationships.notes: Verified content lineage is strong; the remaining question is product/operational lineage, not whether the two repositories share substantial source/content.

verification.reproducibility: Observed-head recursive Git tree comparison is reproducible from the two commit SHAs; the review record now stores the aggregate counts and representative blob identities.
falsifiers: A complete manifest/history audit shows the matching files originated from a different common source and the repos are not operationally related.
Broader comparison shows the observed identical files are isolated vendor/generated artifacts rather than project-authored lineage.

next_test: Combine the manifest comparison with commit-level provenance for representative identical/diverged paths, then classify the relationship as successor, parallel rewrite, extraction, or coexistence.
